children: Disseqt wins KPMG Global Tech Innovator Ireland 2026

Mindflair plc, the AIM-quoted company focused on investing in Artificial Intelligence ("AI") related technology, is pleased to announce that Disseqt AI Limited ("Disseqt"), a portfolio company of Mindflair, held within Sure Valley Ventures' ("SVV") third fund ("SVV3"), in which Mindflair holds an interest, has won the KPMG Global Tech Innovator ("GTI") Ireland competition for 2026.

Disseqt will represent Ireland at the global final at Web Summit in Lisbon in November 2026, competing against national winners from 20 other countries. Disseqt provides an AI assurance platform that helps enterprises test and monitor AI systems, apply operational guardrails and support compliance with frameworks including the EU AI Act and ISO/IEC 42001.
Mindflair has built a portfolio of over 30 AI-focused companies to date, supporting these businesses as they develop their technologies and scale internationally.
Nicholas Lee, Director of Mindflair plc, commented:

"We are pleased to see Disseqt named as Ireland's winner of the KPMG Global Tech Innovator competition. This recognition highlights the company's progress in helping enterprises deploy and operate AI safely and reliably. Participation in the global final provides an important opportunity to showcase its technology internationally and build relationships to support its growth ambitions."
The Directors of the Company are responsible for the release of this announcement. The person who arranged for the release of this information is Nicholas Lee, a director of the Company.

Mindflair plc (AIM: MFAI) is an investment company providing investors with access to a portfolio of next generation technology businesses focused on AI with significant growth potential. The Company is building an investment portfolio of high-tech businesses focused on Artificial Intelligence, across such areas as Internet of Things, Cyber Security, Machine Learning, Immersive Technologies and Big Data, which the Board believes demonstrate evidence of traction and the potential for exponential growth, due to increasing global demand for development in these sectors. For further information, visit: http://www.mindflair.tech/.

Disseqt is an AI assurance company providing a platform that helps enterprises test, monitor and govern AI systems. Its technology is designed to identify issues, apply operational guardrails and generate evidence to support the safe, reliable and compliant deployment of AI across enterprise environments. For more information please visit: https://www.disseqt.ai
